import re

def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line into a dictionary.

    Expected format (standard combined log format):
    <ip> - - [<timestamp>] "<method> <path> <protocol>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<user_agent>"

    Returns a dict with keys: ip, timestamp, method, path, protocol, status, bytes, referer, user_agent.
    Returns None if the line cannot be parsed.
    """
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'^(?P<ip>\S+)'
        r' - - '
        r'\[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\]'
        r' "(?P<method>\S+)'
        r' (?P<path>[^\s]+)'
        r' (?P<protocol>[^\s]+)"'
        r' (?P<status>\d+)'
        r' (?P<bytes>\d+)'
        r' "(?P<referer>[^"]*)"'
        r' "(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"'
        r'$'
    )
    match = pattern.match(line.strip())
    if not match:
        return None

    return {
        'ip': match.group('ip'),
        'timestamp': match.group('timestamp'),
        'method': match.group('method'),
        'path': match.group('path'),
        'protocol': match.group('protocol'),
        'status': int(match.group('status')),
        'bytes': int(match.group('bytes')),
        'referer': match.group('referer'),
        'user_agent': match.group('user_agent'),
    }
